name: ZimaMC
tagline: Your own Minecraft server in a few clicks, for ZimaOS and Windows.
description:
A web app that lets anyone create and run Minecraft Java servers without touching a terminal. Pick a name, a game and a size, and ZimaMC does the rest.

Supports Paper, Folia, Vanilla, Fabric and Forge, with per-server memory and CPU limits, plugins and mods from Modrinth, world pre-generation with Chunky, incremental backups, a live console, a file manager and three ways to let friends join: UPnP, your own Cloudflare domain, or a playit.gg tunnel.
